name: Hiveborn benefits
summary: 4.1 Hiveborn Raised in the brutal density of a hive city. Allowed Species: Human, Ratling, rare Ogryn. Skill Proficiency: Choose one from Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth. Crowd Rat: You ignore difficult terrain caused by crowds, rubble, cramped spaces, pipes, gantries, and dense urban clutter. Seen Worse: You have advantage on saving throws against fear caused by gore, violence, intimidation, or battlefield horror.
